transcription: For lovers of Ivy, Prep and Trans-style, Maine in Geoda City in Tokyo is an absolute must visit. It's full to the brim with classic American staples. From classic sportswear to more formal pieces, I loved every single thing about this store. Also, whilst you're in the area, just around the corner, there's a fantastic vintage magazine store called Magneath, which is fully stocked up on past issues of essential Japanese menswear magazines. There is absolutely so much choice. You'll find so many different copies of back issues of Popeye, men's club, free and easy, and more. You name it, they've got it.

도쿄의 푸딩 노포, 헷케룬 커피 & 푸딩입니다.

할아버지 푸딩으로도 잘 알려져 있죠? 점보 크기의 푸딩으로 부드럽고 풍부한 맛의 푸딩은 한입 베어 물면 기분을 좋게 만들어줘요. 푸딩을 만드는 장인의 스냅은 신의 왼손으로 불릴 만큼 정교하답니다. 이날은 기분이 좋으셨는지 포즈도 취해주셨어요.

내부는 약 20석 규모인데 입장과 퇴장이 일괄적으로 진행되어 대기시간이 길 수 있으니, 첫 타임 방문을 추천드려요. 특히, 푸딩은 인기 많아 오후 1~2시면 품절되기도 하니 서두르는 것이 좋습니다!

*평일 8시 40분 도착, 첫번째 대기 

 [헷케룬 커피 & 푸딩 Hekkerun Coffee & Pudding] 
- 위치: Tokyo, Minato City, Nishishinbashi, 1−20−11 
- 영업: 수.토.일 휴무, 09:00 - 15:00
- 메뉴: 점보푸딩 & 커피 세트 (900엔)

Also known as “Grandpa’s Pudding,” their signature jumbo pudding is incredibly soft and packed with flavor, bringing joy with every bite. The artisan’s skill in crafting the pudding is so precise that they’ve earned the nickname “God’s Left Hand.” On this visit, the artisan was in a great mood and even struck a pose for the camera!

The shop has about 20 seats, and entry and exit are managed in batches, which can result in long wait times. We recommend arriving early for the first seating. Their pudding is so popular that it often sells out by 1–2 PM, so plan accordingly!

*Arrived at 8:40 AM on a weekday and was first in line.
